name: slop-alarm
description: Slop Alarm: a free, bring-your-own-key Chrome extension that flags AI-written text using the Jev decision model (TypeSafe or OpenRouter).

scripts.build: npm run build -w @slop-alarm/core && npm run build -w @slop-alarm/extension
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @slop-alarm/core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev:extension: npm run build -w @slop-alarm/core && npm run dev -w @slop-alarm/extension
scripts.eval: npm run build -w @slop-alarm/core && npm run eval -w @slop-alarm/eval --
scripts.zip: npm run build -w @slop-alarm/core && npm run zip -w @slop-alarm/extension
